records.source: But, unbeknownst to our hero, the evil outlaw is watching from a nearby cliff...
records.translation: Ngunit lingid sa kaalaman ng ating bayani, nagmamasid ang masamang tulisan mula sa kalapit na bangin...

records.source: 'At last, I'll do away with that self-righteous sheriff and make off with the treasure... I deserve it!'
records.translation: “Sa wakas, maaalis ko na ang mapagmagaling na seripeng iyon at matatangay ang kayamanan... Karapat-dapat ito sa akin!”

records.source: 'Whoops! Looks like this avalanche is headed straight for the wagon train.'
records.translation: “Naku! Mukhang dumidiretso sa karaban ng mga bagon ang pagguho ng niyebe.”

records.source: The Prairie King hears a faint rumbling in the distance... Look!
records.translation: Nakarinig ang Hari ng Kapatagan ng mahinang dagundong sa malayo... Tingnan mo!

records.source: Thinking quickly, he fires a shot.
records.translation: Mabilis siyang nag-isip at nagpaputok.

records.source: But what's this? Water's flying everywhere!
records.translation: Pero ano ito? Tumitilamsik ang tubig kung saan-saan!

records.source: He's done it again! The thick mud stops the avalanche in its tracks.
records.translation: Nagawa na naman niya! Pinigil ng makapal na putik ang pagguho ng niyebe.

records.source: The wagon train is saved.
records.translation: Ligtas na ang karaban ng mga bagon.

records.source: The End.
records.translation: Wakas.

records.source: Wumbus
records.preserveReason: Fictional proper title intentionally retained unchanged in Filipino.

records.source: An absurd sci-fi comedy centered around the life and times of a lumpy guy from another star.
records.translation: Isang kakatwang komedyang kathang-agham tungkol sa buhay at kapanahunan ng bukol-bukol na nilalang mula sa ibang bituin.

records.source: 'Wumbus'
records.translation: “Wumbus”

records.source: Wumbus, always at ease, stretches out and enjoys the warmth of his planet's sun.
records.translation: Palaging panatag si Wumbus habang nag-uunat at nagpapakasarap sa init ng araw ng kaniyang planeta.

records.source: His faithful servant, FoodBot, provides a steady stream of fried gluten pucks and 'red sauce'.
records.translation: Tuloy-tuloy na naghahain ang tapat niyang tagapaglingkod na si FoodBot ng piniritong bilog na gluten at “pulang sarsa”.

records.source: Wumbus tries to get his nephew, Rossel, interested in star-system culture and affairs, but Rossel is unimpressed.
records.translation: Sinusubukan ni Wumbus na gawing interesado ang pamangkin niyang si Rossel sa kultura at mga usapin ng sistema ng mga bituin, pero hindi humahanga si Rossel.

records.source: 'Pshhaw!'
records.translation: “Pshaa!”

records.source: The movie is a humorous slice-of-life into Wumbus' strange world, a world where technology and society have 'advanced' to an extreme degree.
records.translation: Ang pelikula ay nakatatawang sulyap sa pang-araw-araw na buhay sa kakaibang mundo ni Wumbus, isang mundong sukdulan na ang “pag-unlad” ng teknolohiya at lipunan.

records.source: Many scenes attempt to find humor in the absurdity of the modern lifestyle.
records.translation: Ginagawang katatawanan ng maraming tagpo ang kabalintunaan ng makabagong pamumuhay.

records.source: But, despite having near-infinite entertainment options, Wumbus and his group of friends still enjoy gathering for a delicious meal of 'pizza' (formed from 100% gluten materials).
records.translation: Ngunit kahit halos walang hanggan ang mapagpipiliang libangan, nasisiyahan pa rin si Wumbus at ang kaniyang mga kaibigan na magsama-sama para sa masarap na “pizza” na gawa sa 100% gluten.

records.source: The Zuzu City Express
records.translation: Ang Ekspres ng Lungsod ng Zuzu

records.source: A beloved movie classic, carefully restored for modern theaters.
records.translation: Isang minamahal na klasikong pelikula na maingat na isinaayos para sa mga makabagong sinehan.

records.source: 'The Zuzu City Express'
records.translation: “Ang Ekspres ng Lungsod ng Zuzu”
